unit: 중1 L5 본문 — Who Threw a Cake at the Monalisa?
parts: 중1 L5 본문 — Who Threw a Cake at the Monalisa?
body: Last Saturday, someone threw a cake at the Monalisa in the Botero Museum in Bogota, Colombia. There were four eyewitnesses. What did they say? Read the following, and find the criminal. Ann Jones, a visitor I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting. I turned around and saw an old man. He was standing in front of a wheelchair. I’m about 170 cm tall, and he was a little taller than me. Carlos Diaz, a janitor An old man with gray hair was running away, and something fell off his head. It was his wig. I ran after him, but I couldn’t catch him. He was faster than me. In fact, the old man was not old. He was a young man with long brown hair. Diego Perez, a guard I went to the crime scene, and there were pieces of cake all over the painting. There was also a wheelchair near the painting, and I found a cake box next to the wheelchair. The box was from Camila’s Bakery. Camila Santos, the owner of Camila’s Bakery Last Friday, a young man came in. I spoke to him in Spanish, but he didn’t understand me. He spoke only English. We had a lot of different cakes, but he just wanted the smallest one. We sold only one cake that day, so I remember him clearly. Oh, he had blue eyes. Now, look at the information about the suspects. Who threw the cake at the Monalisa?

items.correct: threw a cake at the Monalisa
items.why_ko: '~을 향해(공격적으로) 던지다'는 throw A at B로 쓰며, to는 건네주는 느낌이고 전치사를 빼면 문장이 성립하지 않아요.
items.rationale: 'throw A at B'(~을 향해 던지다)의 고정 전치사 at. to/into 로 바꾸거나 전치사를 삭제한 오답(threw a cake the Monalisa)을 유도하기 쉬운 자리
items.sentence: Last Saturday, someone threw a cake at the Monalisa in the Botero Museum in Bogota, Colombia.

verify_dropped.wrong: threw a cake to the Monalisa
verify_dropped.note_ko: 문법 형태는 가능하나 throw A to B는 받으라고 던지는 뜻이어서 그림 대상에는 뜻이 통하지 않음.

items.why_ko: 건물 안 공간을 나타낼 때는 in을 써요. on은 표면 위라는 뜻이라 어울리지 않아요.
items.rationale: 건물·공간 내부를 나타내는 in. at/on 으로 교체하는 빈칸 선지가 자주 출제됨
items.sentence: Last Saturday, someone threw a cake at the Monalisa in the Botero Museum in Bogota, Colombia.

items.correct: Read the following, and find the criminal.
wrong: Read the following, and finding the criminal.
Read the following, and finds the criminal.
items.why_ko: and로 이어진 두 명령문은 모두 동사원형이어야 해서 finding·finds는 안 돼요.
items.rationale: and 로 연결된 두 명령문(동사원형 Read / find)의 병렬. 뒤를 finding 이나 finds 로 바꾸는 병렬 파괴 오답 가능
items.sentence: Read the following, and find the criminal.

items.why_ko: 과거 어느 순간 진행 중이던 동작이므로 과거진행 was looking이 맞아요.
items.rationale: 과거 진행 중이던 동작(was looking)과 그 사이 일어난 단순과거(threw)의 시제 대비. am looking / looked 로 바꾸는 오답 유도
items.sentence: Ann Jones, a visitor I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting.

verify_dropped.note_ko: 단순과거도 어법상 맞음. 진행의 뉘앙스만 사라짐.

items.why_ko: '~앞에'는 굳어진 표현 in front of로 써요. the를 넣으면 '(내부의) 앞부분'이 되고, in을 빼면 틀려요.
items.rationale: 위치를 나타내는 구전치사 in front of. in the front of / front of 처럼 형태를 흔들거나 전치사를 빼는 오답이 가능
items.sentence: He was standing in front of a wheelchair.

verify_dropped.wrong: in the front of a wheelchair
verify_dropped.note_ko: 형태는 가능하나 '휠체어 앞부분 안쪽'이라는 뜻이 되어 어색함.

items.why_ko: 비교급을 강조할 땐 a little/much를 쓰고 very는 못 써요. taller에 more를 또 붙이는 것도 틀려요.
items.rationale: 비교급 강조 부사 a little(= a bit) + 비교급 + than. very taller / much more tall / more taller 같은 오답과 구별
items.sentence: I’m about 170 cm tall, and he was a little taller than me.

items.correct: An old man with gray hair was running away
wrong: An old man with gray hair were running away
An old man with gray hair running away
items.why_ko: 주어는 단수 An old man이므로 was를 쓰고, 동사가 아예 빠지면 문장이 안 돼요.
items.rationale: 주어 An old man 과 동사 was 사이에 with gray hair 전치사구가 끼어 있어 were 로 바꾸는 수일치 오답을 심기 좋은 자리
items.sentence: Carlos Diaz, a janitor An old man with gray hair was running away, and something fell off his head.

items.why_ko: fall은 목적어가 없는 자동사라 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요.
items.rationale: fall 은 목적어를 취하지 않는 자동사라 수동태 불가. was fallen off 같은 자동사 수동태 오답 선지가 전형적
items.sentence: Carlos Diaz, a janitor An old man with gray hair was running away, and something fell off his head.

items.why_ko: '뒤쫓다'는 run after로 굳어진 표현이라 after를 빼거나 to로 바꾸면 뜻이 달라져요.
items.rationale: run after(~를 뒤쫓다)의 고정 전치사 after. ran to / ran him 처럼 전치사 교체·삭제 오답 가능
items.sentence: I ran after him, but I couldn’t catch him.

verify_dropped.note_ko: 어법상 맞는 표현이며 뜻만 '그에게 달려갔다'로 바뀜.

items.why_ko: 조동사 could 뒤에는 항상 동사원형 catch가 와요.
items.rationale: 조동사 could 뒤 동사원형. couldn’t caught / couldn’t catching 형태 오류 유도
items.sentence: I ran after him, but I couldn’t catch him.

items.why_ko: fast는 1음절이라 -er을 붙여 비교급을 만들고, than 앞에 최상급은 쓸 수 없어요.
items.rationale: 1음절 형용사/부사 fast 의 비교급 -er. more fast / fastest 오답과 구별
items.sentence: He was faster than me.

items.why_ko: '사실은'은 In fact로 굳어진 표현이에요.
items.rationale: 굳어진 부사구 In fact 의 앞 전치사. On fact / At fact 로 바꾸는 빈칸 선지가 자주 나옴
items.sentence: In fact, the old man was not old.

items.correct: there were pieces of cake all over the painting
wrong: there was pieces of cake all over the painting
there are pieces of cake all over the painting
items.why_ko: There be 뒤 진짜 주어가 복수 pieces이고 시제도 과거라 were가 맞아요.
items.rationale: There be 구문에서 실제 주어는 복수 pieces 이므로 were. there was 로 바꾼 수일치 오답이 전형적
items.sentence: Diego Perez, a guard I went to the crime scene, and there were pieces of cake all over the painting.

items.why_ko: 주어가 단수 a wheelchair이고 과거 이야기라 was를 써요.
items.rationale: 단수 주어 a wheelchair 에 맞춘 was. were 로 바꾸는 오답 유도 (앞 문장의 were 와 대조시키기 좋음)
items.sentence: There was also a wheelchair near the painting, and I found a cake box next to the wheelchair.

items.why_ko: '~옆에'는 next to로 쓰며 of를 쓰거나 to를 빼면 틀려요.
items.rationale: 근접 위치의 next to. next of / near to 등으로 흔드는 빈칸 출제 가능
items.sentence: There was also a wheelchair near the painting, and I found a cake box next to the wheelchair.

wrong: a young man was come in
a young man was came in
items.why_ko: come은 자동사라 수동태로 쓰지 않아요.
items.rationale: come 은 자동사로 수동태가 불가능. was come in 같은 자동사 수동태 오답 선지를 만들 수 있는 자리
items.sentence: Camila Santos, the owner of Camila’s Bakery Last Friday, a young man came in.

items.why_ko: speak는 사람 앞에 to, 언어 앞에 in이 필요해요.
items.rationale: speak to + 사람 / in + 언어. spoke him, spoke to him Spanish 처럼 전치사 삭제 오답 유도
items.sentence: I spoke to him in Spanish, but he didn’t understand me.

items.why_ko: 여러 케이크 중 하나를 고르니 최상급 the smallest가 맞고, small은 -est를 붙여요.
items.rationale: 셋 이상(a lot of different cakes) 중 하나를 고르므로 최상급 + the. smaller / most small 오답과 구별
items.sentence: We had a lot of different cakes, but he just wanted the smallest one.

verify_dropped.note_ko: 어법상 성립하는 비교급 표현으로 의미만 달라짐.

items.why_ko: 단수 명사 day를 가리키는 지시형용사 that을 그대로 써야 하고 관사를 덧붙이거나 복수형을 쓸 수 없어요.
items.rationale: 명사 day 를 수식하는 지시형용사 that. 접속사·관계대명사 that 과 쓰임이 다른 것 고르기 문항 재료
items.sentence: We sold only one cake that day, so I remember him clearly.

items.why_ko: 동사 remember를 꾸미므로 부사 clearly를 쓰고, 목적어 앞에 끼워 넣지 않아요.
items.rationale: 동사 remember 를 수식하므로 부사 clearly. clear 로 바꾸는 형용사·부사 혼동 오답이 전형적
items.sentence: We sold only one cake that day, so I remember him clearly.

items.correct: look at the information about the suspects
wrong: look the information about the suspects
items.why_ko: '보다'는 look at이고 '~에 관한 정보'는 information about이라 at을 빼거나 of로 바꾸면 어색해요.
items.rationale: look at(~을 보다)의 at 과 information about(~에 관한 정보)의 about. 전치사 삭제·교체 오답 가능
items.sentence: Now, look at the information about the suspects.

verify_dropped.wrong: look at the information of the suspects
verify_dropped.note_ko: about보다 덜 자연스럽지만 어법상 틀리지 않음.
